p.me: \begin{aligned} \int 216 \cos^4(18 x)dx \amp = 216 \int \left( \cos^2(18 x) \right)^2 dx \\\\ \amp = 216 \int \left( \frac 1 2 (1 + \cos(36 x)) \right)^2 dx \\\\ \amp = 54 \left( \int dx + 2 \int \cos(36 x) dx + \int \cos^2(36 x) dx \right) \\\\ \amp = 54 \left( x + \frac{1}{18} \sin(36 x) + \int \frac 1 2 \left(1 + \cos(72 x)\right) dx \right) \\\\ \amp = 54 \left( x + \frac{1}{18} \sin(36 x) + \frac 1 2 \int dx + \frac 1 2 \int \cos(72 x)dx \right) \\\\ \amp = 54 \left( x + \frac{1}{18} \sin(36 x) + \frac x 2 + \frac{1}{144} \sin(72 x) \right) \\\\ \amp = 81 x + 3 \sin(36 x) + \frac{54}{144} \sin(72 x) \end{aligned}
